item.title: Match Preview: AFC Totton (H)

item.title: Lannin-Sweet Loan Extended

item.title: Rashawn Scott joins Chippenham on Loan
item.description: We can confirm that Rashawn Scott has joined fellow National League South side Chippenham Town on loan until the end of the season. The post Rashawn Scott joins Chippenham on Loan appeared first on Dagenham & Redbridge FC.

item.title: Ticketing Update v Totton
item.description: Tickets will be available at the turnstiles from 1:30 pm. We are aware of an issue in selling tickets online via our ticketing platform, TIXR, for today’s game and are currently working on a solution. The post Ticketing Update v Totton appeared first on Dagenham & Redbridge FC.
